values.Description: A 20-liter bucket that warms two oversized bath towels, a robe, or a blanket for a spa-style finish to a shower. It plugs into any outlet, has a wood-grain base and lid handle, and shuts off after 60 minutes.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 to replace the Amba T-2536 (hardwired, not on Amazon) | Rating: 4.5 from 6,323 (Amazon); Bob Vila tested it Best Overall; seller: ships from Amazon (seller 100% positive), no Trustpilot or BBB profile found | Copycat of Brookstone: kept because popular in its own right: the most-rated towel warmer on Amazon (1K+ bought a month), while Brookstone's earlier bucket rates 4.0 and is no longer sold on brookstone.com | Note: brand-site price $146.99 entered; Amazon sold the same 20L CL1 for $89.99 on 10/3 | Price set to the Amazon price (Buy goes to Amazon first); keenray.com lists it at $146.99
